The '''Imperial Outpost''' on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] was a military outpost established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when a permanent garrison was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==History==
[[File:DantImperialOutpost.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A view of the Dantooine Imperial Outpost at dusk]]
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the outpost was commanded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jatrian Lytus]]. Among the other Imperial personnel stationed at this outpost were [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bek Rabor]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Juntah Herm]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[LX-466]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] [[SG-567]] and [[SG-619]], [[Black Epsilon]] pilot trainer [[Insurgent]] and the researcher [[Xaan Talmaron]].

The outpost featured a landing pad for interstellar shuttles, a small medical facility with a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] and a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Its perimeter was guarded by patrolling stormtroopers and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]].
